mapper.sql: id, user_id, template_id, status, stage, failure_stage, failure_reason, result_url, created_at, updated_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, user_id, template_id, status, stage) VALUES (#{task.id}, #{task.userId}, #{task.templateId}, #{task.status}, #{task.stage})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM task WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = #{stage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage = 'COMPLETED', failure_stage = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, result_url = #{resultUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', stage = 'FAILED', failure_stage = #{failureStage}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, result_url = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
